issue_context.title: Refactor kubelet convertStatusToAPIStatus
issue_context.body:
The kubelet's `convertStatusToAPIStatus()` in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/kubelet/kubelet_pods.go iterates `podStatus` 3 times in order to construct the 3 container status lists in `PodStatus`. This could be refactored to make a single pass through `podStatus`.

/kind cleanup
/sig node
comments: Hi, I would like to contribute to this.
#59484 has merged so this is fully unblocked. @praveensastry do you still plan on working on this?

/priority backlog
/good-first-issue

ok, maybe this doesn't meet all of the good first issue criteria.

/remove-good-first-issue
/area kubelet
I would like contribute to this。

@Rand01ph great! Your help would be most appreciated. Feel free to ask questions in issue.

@praveensastry I haven't heard from you, have you made any progress? Do you want to work with @Rand01ph or hand it off?
@verb I think I will refactoring the func `convertToAPIContainerStatuses()` and can handle all type of container such as `InitContainer` or `EphemeralContainer`, whitout some func args。

@Rand01ph I think that would address the problem, but I'm not sure exactly what you have in mind. Here's what I had in mind:

When `convertStatusToAPIStatus()` was written, there was a single list of containers, so it iterated that list to covert statuses. Now there are 3 lists of containers, but still only a single list of `kubecontainer.ContainerStatus`, so it probably makes more sense to iterate that list instead, sorting into the 3 types of container statuses.

It's this piece of code with the passing in of additional information as function arguments that feels like the abstraction is no longer quite right:

```
	apiPodStatus.ContainerStatuses = kl.convertToAPIContainerStatuses(
		pod, podStatus,
		oldPodStatus.ContainerStatuses,
		pod.Spec.Containers,
		len(pod.Spec.InitContainers) > 0,
		false,
	)
	apiPodStatus.InitContainerStatuses = kl.convertToAPIContainerStatuses(
		pod, podStatus,
		oldPodStatus.InitContainerStatuses,
		pod.Spec.InitContainers,
		len(pod.Spec.InitContainers) > 0,
		true,
	)
	if utilfeature.DefaultFeatureGate.Enabled(features.EphemeralContainers) {
...
		apiPodStatus.EphemeralContainerStatuses = kl.convertToAPIContainerStatuses(
			pod, podStatus,
			oldPodStatus.EphemeralContainerStatuses,
			ecSpecs,
			len(pod.Spec.InitContainers) > 0,
			false,
		)
	}
```

Iterating `kubecontainer.ContainerStatus` may not be quite right since it's possibly incompleted, but I haven't looked into it enough. An alternative may be to use `ContainerVisitor`, but since it requires different action per container type you'd need #82192 to be merged first.

No matter what, the first step here is to ensure good test coverage. Good test coverage should give us confidence that we haven't changed any behavior.

@yylt is interested in working on this, too. You two should coordinate so you don't duplicate effort. Thank you both for your help!
@verb Thanks, I'll write some test for `convertStatusToAPIStatus()`  before refactoring.

Hi, @yylt . I think the `oldPodStatus` only used by `convertStatusToAPIStatus()`. So, maybe refactoring `convertToAPIContainerStatuses()` just like below:

`convertToAPIContainerStatuses(pod *v1.Pod, podStatus *kubecontainer.PodStaus, apiPodStatus *v1.PodStatus)
`
